step_section.name: A. Existence of a contract
step_section.instructions:
A. Contract exists if: 
i. Collection is considered probable 
ii. It has commercial substance 
iii. Rights to goods and services and payment terms can be identified 
iv. It is approved and the parties are committed to their obligations

section.name: Existence of a contract
section.instructions: Please fill out the following questions if answer is 'Yes':

questions.question: Is the contract approved and the parties are committed to their obligation ((ASC 606-10-25-1(a) ) ?

“The Services shall be described and set forth in work orders (each a “WO”)… and incorporated herein by this reference… All the rights and obligations of XYZs and Vendor… as set out in this Agreement shall apply respectively to the parties signing the applicable WO.”

step_section.name: B. Combination of contracts
step_section.instructions:
Accounted for as a single contract if one or more of the following criteria are met: 
1. Contracts were negotiated as a single commercial package; 
2. Consideration in one contract depends on the other contract; or 
3. Goods and services are a single performance obligation

section.name: Analyzing combination contracts
section.instruction: Please fill out the following questions if answer is 'Yes':

questions.question: Are there any contracts entered into at or near the same time (rebuttable presumption 3 months) with the same customer or related parties of the customer? (ASC 606-10-25-9)

section.name: Is there a combination of contracts necessary (606-10-25-9) ?

questions.question: Contracts were negotiated as a package with a single commercial objective (e.g. contract would be loss-making without taking into account the consideration received under another contract)?
Consideration in one contract depends on price or performance of the other contract (e.g. failure to perform under one contract affect the amount paid under another contract)?
questions.analysis: "The Service Levels should be designed so that achieving a Service Levels is not dependent on achieving any other Service Levels."  | "The “At Risk Amount” represents the maximum monthly amount of Service Credits for which the Vendor may be liable in respect of a Service Level Default for a specific services under a Work Order, which shall not exceed 10% of the invoice amount."

questions.question: Goods or services promised in the contracts (or some goods or services promised in each contract) are a single performance obligation in accordance with paragraphs 606-10-25-14 through 25-22 ?
questions.analysis: "The Services shall be described and set forth in work orders (each a "WO")..."  | "Following the signing of any WO, XYZs shall issue to Vendor a purchase order (each, a "Purchase Order") specifying the applicable quantities, Fees, and delivery specifications with respect to the Project Deliverables."  | "Unless specifically provided otherwise in an WO, XYZs shall... evaluate any Project Deliverables... If any Project Deliverable does not meet the requirements... XYZs shall... have the right... to withdraw from this Agreement or a WO entirely or only in respect to the defaulting parts of the Project Deliverable..."  | "'Project Deliverable(s)' means any tangible or intangible product(s), deliverables and work results that Vendor delivers to XYZs as part of a Project or the Services... which may include... information, reports, specifications, software... and any other products, deliverables and work results..."

section.name: Conclusion
section.instruction: If one or more of the above questions are answered with 'Yes', the contracts should be combined.

questions.question: Conclusion
questions.expected_answer: No contracts are combined as none of the above criteria are met.

questions.answer: {{Payment net 30 from receipt of correct, undisputed invoice; services defined via WOs with POs issued; ASP/VMS may process invoices with up to 3% fees deducted; BPO vendor access to agreement/docs authorized; acceptance within 30 days with remediation and additional remedies; invoice disputes allowed within 6 months; invoices must list applicable taxes and XYZs not responsible for certain taxes; expenses reimbursable only with prior written authorization and per Travel Policy; Service Levels to avoid interdependencies; AHT/SLA baselines via Change Control before service credits apply.}}
questions.analysis:
"XYZs shall dispatch payment of an invoice to Vendor within thirty (30) days after the date of receipt of that invoice, provided that the invoice is correct in all material respects ... and not in dispute." 
"The Services shall be described and set forth in work orders (each a \"WO\") which may from time to time be executed by the Parties ..." 
"Following the signing of any WO, XYZs shall issue to Vendor a purchase order (each, a \"Purchase Order\") specifying the applicable quantities, Fees, and delivery specifications ..." 
"The Parties understand that XYZs has elected to utilize the services of an Administrative Services Provider (\"ASP\") ... Vendor agrees to cooperate fully with any ASP designated by XYZs and to fund the ASP and VMS fees, which shall not exceed three percent (3%) of Vendor's total monthly invoice. Vendor agrees that the ASP and VMS fees may be deducted from total monthly invoice fees otherwise to be paid." 
"Vendor hereby authorizes XYZs to provide any such BPO Vendor access to this Agreement and any work orders ... as well as to any products, deliverables and services delivered hereunder ..." 
"Unless specifically provided otherwise in an WO, XYZs shall, within a reasonable period of time (which will not exceed thirty (30) days) examine, test, review or otherwise evaluate any Project Deliverables ... If, after re-delivery ... XYZs shall, in its sole discretion, have the right (a) to keep the Project Deliverable and to deduct ... (b) ... withdraw ... (c) to employ a third party to correct the default ... (d) request Vendor to continue to remedy ... (e) ... compensate XYZs in full for any and all reasonable losses ..." 
"XYZs may dispute the correctness of an invoice within six (6) months from the date of receipt of the relevant invoice and may withhold payment of any Fees on an invoice that it disputes in good faith while the Parties work to resolve any such dispute." 
"Unless otherwise agreed, invoices shall include and list all applicable taxes proposed to be charged to XYZs as separate items. XYZs shall not be responsible for (i) any taxes not so separately listed ... (ii) the remittance of taxes to applicable tax authorities; or (iii) ad valorem, franchise, privilege, value-added or occupational taxes or any taxes or other governmental payments based on the income, employees, payroll, property or capital of Vendor." 
"Vendor shall not be entitled to reimbursement for any expenses without the prior written authorization of XYZs." 
"Travel and travel-related expenses shall only be reimbursable by XYZs as a result of a specific written request by XYZs and may be billed to XYZs only at actual cost, in conformity with XYZs' Travel Policy ..." 
"The Service Levels should be designed so that achieving a Service Levels is not dependent on achieving any other Service Levels." 
"AHT’s for all activities need to be baselined and mutually agreed through a Change Control Procedure prior to any Service Credits being applicable."
